h2: Jaguar XE Ingenium Diesel|Timing Chain Issues?|
description: The pre-facelift Ingenium diesel (AJ200D) is known for timing chain and injector seal wear — a pattern shared across the wider JLR Ingenium engine family. We replace worn timing chains and injector seals as standard on every Ingenium diesel rebuild.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: Ford EcoBoost (pre-2017) injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Jaguar specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes — both verified: Ford EcoBoost (pre-2017) widely documented with multiple TSBs; M156 pre-2012 established Jaguar specialist pattern.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras — just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
